faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad, a premier institution offering legal education and conducting specialized research projects in various domains of law.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NALSAR?
faq.answer: NALSAR has advertised for the post of Legal Consultant (Maritime Law) on a contractual basis to handle specific legal research and consultancy assignments.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Legal Consultant (Maritime Law) position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 18-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an LL.M in Maritime Law, LL.M in Insurance Law, LL.M in Maritime Security Law, or LL.M in International Law from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for NALSAR Legal Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates should be below 35 years of age as on 30-09-2026 to be eligible for applying to the Legal Consultant position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of ₹60,000/- per month during their contract period at NALSAR.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for these vacancies?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by submitting their details, resumé, statement of purpose, and published articles through the provided Google Form link.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification details, official website link, and the direct online application link in the Important Links section of this article.
